steps.content: When the detectives and the assisting combatants from FAC arrived at the scene, Christina has disappeared. All that is left is a destroyed broken wall and traces of a fierce battle.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Why can't we find her anywhere? Could it be that the kid has been taken by the Corruptors...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: She's an A-Class Sinner after all, she should be quite capable, unless... something happened that made her lose control of her emotions.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: We are now lacking the most effective means to stabilize the Sinners. If their M-value is unstable, it may also attract nearby Mania creatures.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: That would be very dangerous...

The inspector doesn't dare to venture into the contamination, he takes a look from afar. He flips through Christina's last sent detailed on-site investigation clues, confirms the multiple remains sealed in the concrete for many years. He frowns.

The FAC finds a shattered Hypercube near the broken wall, the Corruptors were smashed to pieces, and Christina's cloak was torn off. Even without getting close, one can tell that the battle here was very intense and chaotic not long ago.
The intern's struggle was very fierce, she probably lost control.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: That kid has psychological trauma. If she was the one who smashed this wall and saw what was inside...
One day ago...

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Psychological trauma? Why didn't you say so earlier?! And you put her on our team??

steps.speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
steps.content: ...This task was originally recommended by the higher-ups, no one expected it would cause this much trouble. I can only ask you to take care of her.

steps.speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
steps.content: That child's father is a FAC instructor. The soldiers who were good to her family, and the whole team died in a secret operation. Yes, in <color=#fb9259>N.F. 103</color>...

steps.speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
steps.content: There were too many rumors about FAC in those years, and many people involved would think negatively. Her mother later died from excessive worry. Christina was hit hard and caused a lot of trouble.

steps.speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
steps.content: A kind family adopted her. Christina herself is trying to recover. She's very motivated, and she even got into the police academy. But there's always a fear of the unexpected.

steps.speaker: FAC Mid-Level Management
steps.content: Her parents were also FAC combatants who recently fell in the West District operation. That child always tries to act tough... I don't know if she can keep it up...

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Tsk, N.F. 103 again. I should've gotten rid of her sooner... And she shouldn't have come alone!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Chris—! Where are you? Answer me! Chris—!
He yells anxiously, walking farther and farther under the night sky, when suddenly a faint noise comes from the debris nearby. The inspector immediately draws his gun and takes aim...

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: ...! You are...
When Christina wakes up, she is surrounded by pitch blackness. The silent darkness finally frees her from the violent chaos of her nightmare.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: It's a dream... Not real... I'm on a case... I...
You finally woke up.
